Sub: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Receipt of
Order.

In terms of Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)
Regulations, 2015, we are pleased to inform you that the company has received an order worth
Rs. 3,13,57,320/- (Inclusive of all Duties and Taxes) from HQ Eastern Command, Indian Army,
Ministry of Defence (Army), Government of India, for supply of 9 MM Carbine Machine Gun. ‘

It’s a proud moment for Lokesh Machines Limited for achieving this feat as an Indigenous
Private Sector manufacturer of Small Arms. This follows after the successful delivery of
weapons by Lokesh Machines Limited to the Northern Command in September 2024 thus
marking its proud presence in two active commands of the Indian Army.
